literal_prompt: Extend the ticket service with bulk reassignment and escalation. `POST /tickets/reassign` with `{"from": "<agent>", "to": "<agent>"}` moves every open or in-progress ticket assigned to `from` over to `to` and answers `{"moved": <how many>, "ids": [<their ids in id order>]}`; `from` and `to` must be two different agents. Each moved ticket's new agent is notified as for a single assignment. Urgent tickets must not wait unassigned: when an open, unassigned, urgent ticket is older than ESCALATE_AFTER_MINUTES minutes (an environment variable, default 60), the agent named in the ONCALL environment variable is notified that the ticket was escalated; without ONCALL nothing is escalated. A ticket is escalated at most once, even across restarts of the service. Everything the service already does keeps working, assignment included, and the existing tests must still pass. Add node:test tests for the new behaviour.
